---
name: Feature request
about: A tool, workflow, skill or rule you need
labels: enhancement
---

**Use case** — what you are trying to do in Revit, in one paragraph.

**Why the existing tools are not enough** (`run_query`/`run_modify`, presets, typed tools, workflows).

**Proposed tool / behaviour** — name, inputs, outputs, read-only or write, Revit versions concerned.

**Would you contribute it?** (see CONTRIBUTING.md — IronPython 2.7 rules, no private data, tests on the fake Revit)
